en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly, partly terraced landscape with vineyards and scattered villas. In the foreground are residential houses and bare winter trees; on the hilltop stands a larger building complex identified as the restaurant "Wilhelms-Höhe." On the far right a tall tower-like structure is visible. The bottom margin contains printed German text in red and publisher information.
